seoTitle: Teen Titans Test: Which Character Are You? (11 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Teen Titans test: 11 everyday questions reveal whether you're Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Raven, Beast Boy, Terra or Slade — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the driven leader, the quiet one with hidden power, or the joker who keeps everyone laughing? Answer 11 everyday questions about friends, trust and teamwork, and find out which Teen Titans character you are.

characters.name: Robin
characters.title: The Leader
characters.summary: Disciplined, driven and always in charge. You don't need superpowers, because you've got focus and a plan.
description: Like Robin, you're a natural leader. He's the intelligent, capable leader of the Teen Titans.
You don't need superpowers. Robin has none, but he's disciplined and leads the team well.
You go your own way. Robin left his mentor, Batman, to fight crime on his own.
characters.flaw: You get so focused on one goal that you forget everything else.
characters.signature: A strict training plan, a serious face and a mission you won't let go of.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn a fun day out into a training exercise

characters.name: Starfire
characters.title: The Princess
characters.summary: Warm, curious and full of joy. You're excited about everything, and you love your friends with your whole heart.
description: Like Starfire, you're curious about everything. She's a quirky alien princess from the planet Tamaran.
You've overcome a lot. Starfire escaped from captors who planned to sell her, and her arrival on Earth led to the Titans forming.
You love deeply. Starfire and Robin have feelings for each other, and they become a couple in Trouble in Tokyo.
characters.flaw: You wear your heart on your sleeve, and it gets hurt easily.
characters.signature: A big smile, a hundred questions and a hug for everyone.
characters.clashReason: they'd ask you a hundred questions about something completely normal

characters.name: Cyborg
characters.title: The Big Brother
characters.summary: Confident, laid-back and brilliant with tech. You're the team's big brother, and you know how to have fun.
description: Like Cyborg, you're brilliant with technology. He's skilled with tech, and incredibly strong.
You've been through a lot. Cyborg was turned into a cyborg to save his life after an accident.
You're the one people rely on. Cyborg is Robin's second-in-command.
characters.flaw: You can get a bit too competitive about games.
characters.signature: A toolbox, a game controller and a big laugh.
characters.clashReason: they'd beat you at every game, then never let you forget it

characters.name: Raven
characters.title: The Quiet One
characters.summary: Calm, private and drily funny. You keep your feelings under control, and you're far stronger than anyone realises.
description: Like Raven, you're calm and private. She's a stoic girl from the parallel world of Azarath.
You've got a lot of power. Raven has vast magical abilities.
You don't let your past define you. Raven is the daughter of the demon Trigon, and she helps the Titans defeat him.
characters.flaw: You keep people at a distance, even when they want to help.
characters.signature: A dark hood, a dry comment and a lot of feelings kept under lock and key.
characters.clashReason: they'd give you a flat stare, and say nothing at all

characters.name: Beast Boy
characters.title: The Joker
characters.summary: Funny, good-natured and big-hearted. You keep everyone laughing, and you never give up on the people you care about.
description: Like Beast Boy, you're a good-natured joker. He's the team's comic relief.
You can adapt to anything. Beast Boy can turn into any animal.
You've got a past. Beast Boy used to be part of the Doom Patrol.
characters.flaw: You crack jokes even when nobody's in the mood.
characters.signature: A terrible joke, a big grin and an animal for every occasion.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a joke while you were trying to be serious

characters.name: Terra
characters.title: The New Girl
characters.summary: Brave, restless and desperate to belong. You've moved around a lot, and you just want a place where you fit.
description: Like Terra, you're always on the move. She's a nomadic girl who can control the earth.
You've been torn between two sides. Terra joined the Titans while secretly working as a double agent for Slade.
You do the right thing in the end. Terra sacrifices herself to stop Slade from destroying Jump City.
characters.flaw: You want to belong so badly that you trust the wrong people.
characters.signature: A backpack, a restless heart and a power you're still learning to control.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep you at arm's length, in case you let them down

characters.name: Slade
characters.title: The Mastermind
characters.summary: Patient, calculating and always three steps ahead. You prefer to pull the strings from the shadows.
description: Like Slade, you're a mastermind. He's the Titans' most recurring enemy, and Robin's archenemy.
You look for potential. Slade tries to make Robin his apprentice.
You always have someone on the inside. Slade recruits Terra to work against the Titans.
characters.flaw: You see other people as pieces in your game.
characters.signature: A calm voice, a half-hidden face and a plan already in motion.
characters.clashReason: they'd quietly turn your friends against you

questions.text: Your friends want a movie night. You...

options.text: Pick the silliest comedy you can find
Pick something dark, and sit in the corner
Get excited about every single snack
Let someone else pick. You're just happy to be invited

questions.text: A day with nothing planned. You spend it...

options.text: Tinkering with gadgets, then a long video game marathon
Somewhere quiet, with a book and no interruptions
Training. Days off are for getting better
Exploring somewhere new, on your own

questions.text: Someone tells a really bad joke. You...

options.text: Laugh harder than anyone. It was probably yours
Don't laugh. Don't speak. Just stare
Laugh politely, even though you didn't get it
Groan, then tell an even worse one

questions.text: You're working on a big group project. You...

options.text: Take charge, and make a plan for everyone
Handle all the tech, and make it look easy
Try really hard to prove you belong on the team
Quietly steer everyone toward what you want

questions.text: You make a big mistake that hurts your friends. You...

options.text: Feel awful, and run away from it
Blame yourself, and work twice as hard to fix it
Apologise to everyone, one by one
Cry, then give everyone a huge hug

questions.text: A new kid joins your group of friends. You...

options.text: Instantly decide they're your favourite
Keep your distance until you trust them
Welcome them with a hundred questions
Work out how they could be useful to you

questions.text: Someone challenges you to a video game. You...

options.text: Accept, and talk trash the whole time
Accept, and treat it like the final battle
Decline, and go somewhere quieter
Let them win, so they underestimate you

questions.text: You're feeling a lot of emotions at once. You...

options.text: Lock them away, and stay calm
Feel every single one, out loud
Act fine, and hope nobody notices
Go and eat an enormous meal

questions.text: Someone you trusted turns out to have been lying to you. You...

options.text: Take it personally, and refuse to let it go
Feel crushed, but still hope they come back
Forgive them, if they're truly sorry
Shrug. You always plan for betrayal

questions.text: A mysterious mentor offers to make you more powerful, if you work for them. You...

options.text: Take it. You've never felt good enough on your own
Refuse, and start investigating them
Sense that something's very wrong, and walk away
Laugh. You can upgrade yourself, thanks

questions.text: You lead a team of young heroes, and they won't stop arguing. You...

options.text: Call a team meeting, and make everyone shake hands
Use the arguments to turn them against each other
Cook everyone a strange dish from your home planet
Turn into a puppy until everyone calms down
